scope: External SciFact scientific abstract/document relevance using standard BEIR qrels; not general passage relevance, factual/clinical truth or NLI accuracy
license: SciFact claims/annotations CC BY 4.0; S2ORC abstracts ODC-By 1.0; https://github.com/allenai/scifact/blob/master/LICENSE.md
limitations: Queries selected from BEIR test qrels (original SciFact public labelled development), not original blind test.
Unjudged documents count as zero only for standard benchmark metrics; this is not proof of irrelevance.
Full retrieval corpus shared intentionally; gold source groups and near-claim variants separated. Topic/undisclosed training overlap unknown.
Any over-limit candidate retains whole-query baseline order; no silent truncation. Small English scientific sample cannot validate Wikipedia/news/Hindi/Telugu.
